message.content:
Step 1: Identify the singer who released the song "The Battle". According to the source [The Battle (George Jones song)], George Jones released the song "The Battle" as the title track of his 1976 LP.
Step 2: Identify the duet partner mentioned in the same source. The source states that the same year, the single "Golden Ring," a duet with his estranged ex-wife Tammy Wynette, became a #1 hit.
Step 3: Verify the birth date of Tammy Wynette. According to the source [Tammy Wynette], she was born on May 5, 1942, which matches the "born in May of 1942" criteria in the question.
Step 4: Confirm that Tammy Wynette is an American country music singer-songwriter, which is also stated in her source.
Final answer: Tammy Wynette

- [Tammy Wynette]: "Tammy Wynette (born Virginia Wynette Pugh; May 5, 1942 – April 6, 1998) was an American country music singer-songwriter..."
Tammy Wynette was born in May of 1942. She sang a duet ("Golden Ring") with her ex-husband George Jones the same year he released "The Battle" (1976).
The answer is Tammy Wynette.
